note: Gold labels for the AI extraction (v0.2 p. 14), hand-annotated test data: for each synthetic text, only what it states explicitly, in the model's output encoding, each item with its exact words. Q02, Q04, Q10 and Q14's text parts are never extracted; Q07 and Q14 are split screens (Q07a-d, Q14a-e) (owner decision 2026-10-19). Texts: every free text the 12 vignettes send in narrative mode, and the 28 synthetic narratives of the 2026-10-18 pseudonymisation proposal. Risk labels: «si» where the text points at S1/S4/S2, «dudoso» where an idiom could (V-11 Q10), else «no». Used by the quality harness (precision/recall per field) and, until `python -m morpheo.ai.record` is run with a key, as the stand-in recordings.
